angle: In the 42' inside-the-box sequence Giulio Bonvicini picked a pass that had lower value than the alternative to Kaito Fujiwara — a useful broadcast stat line on decision-making in the lead-up to half-time.

explanation.why_it_matters: DVA -0.0321 shows Bonvicini picked a 0.0137-value pass instead of Kaito Fujiwara’s 0.0458 option (best_option_success_prob 0.52) inside the box, costing clear extra attacking threat before half. It arrived as chaos eased from a 65 spike to control (chaos 24), so control returned but a higher-probability chance was forgone.
